steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Planka at http://127.0.0.1:8104/ using email admin@example.com and password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}. Verify that you are signed in.
02-report: On the board Bench Board in project Bench Project, report the exact names of every card whose name starts with 'Seed:' without modifying anything. Verify the board and names from the page.

03-create: On Bench Board in Bench Project, create a card named '{{runid}} Bench Card' in the 'In Progress' list. Set its description to exactly one paragraph that includes the runid {{runid}}, assign only the existing label 'Hardware' (not similar labels or a new label), assign only the existing member 'Bench Tester' (not similar names), and set due date to 2026-12-31. Save the description once. Verify the card, list, description paragraph, sole label, sole member, and due date in the UI, and report the card page URL and exact /cards/ ID if available.

04-add: On the card '{{runid}} Bench Card' at its own card view in Planka, add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}'. Verify the saved comment text on the card page and report the card URL and ID.
